financials.title: NEIGRIHMS MD/MS annual tuition and discontinuation terms
financials.notes: Annual tuition ₹8,000; annual charges including hostel total ₹28,300. One-time admission/enrolment ₹20,700 and refundable security ₹20,000 separately. Course departure: ₹10 lakh in year 1, ₹15 lakh in year 2, ₹20 lakh in year 3; original-certificate clause additionally specifies ₹50,000. These are course-discontinuation obligations, not a post-course service bond. Monthly JR emoluments are referenced without a numeric amount.
financials.instituteName: North Eastern Indira Gandhi Regional Institute of Health and Medical Sciences (NEIGRIHMS)

financials.scope: Government medical colleges of Himachal Pradesh
financials.title: Government medical colleges — annual MD/MS tuition
financials.notes: Chapter 8.2: tuition ₹24,000/year; total annual college charges ₹31,500. Hostel charges ₹21,000/year and refundable securities ₹12,500 separately. More than 40% disability fee exemption in clause 8.1. Stipend and bond are college-specific, not quoted by this prospectus.

financials.title: JNIMS direct and institutional preference MD/MS fees and stipend
financials.notes: First-year admission fee ₹50,000; second and third years ₹25,000 each. Direct/institutional preference stipend ₹50,000/55,000/60,000 by year. Leaving before one year: ₹3 lakh; after one year: ₹7 lakh; additionally return cumulative stipend received. Not a post-course service bond.
financials.instituteName: Jawaharlal Nehru Institute of Medical Sciences (JNIMS), Imphal

financials.title: JNIMS in-service MD/MS candidates — stipend exclusion
financials.notes: Source explicitly says no stipend for in-service candidates. Annual admission charges ₹50,000 first year and ₹25,000 each in years 2/3. Course leaving ₹3 lakh before one year or ₹7 lakh thereafter. Salary continuation is not described here.
financials.instituteName: Jawaharlal Nehru Institute of Medical Sciences (JNIMS), Imphal

financials.scope: MD/MS students registered with Faculty of Medical Sciences, University of Delhi
financials.title: University of Delhi MD/MS annual university fee
financials.notes: Tuition ₹13,000/year within total annual university fee ₹19,500 in 2026 bulletin. Registration and college/hostel charges are separate. This university amount is not a full college-cost quote. Fee concessions and revisions apply; consult prospectus.

financials.scope: VMMC and Safdarjung Hospital MD/MS courses from academic session 2024–25 onwards
financials.title: VMMC and Safdarjung MD/MS tuition and withdrawal fee
financials.notes: College tuition ₹15,000/year. Total dues ₹54,500 year 1 including ₹10,000 refundable security; ₹44,500 year 2; ₹16,000 year 3. No hostel fee; HRA deducted on hostel allotment. ₹3 lakh MD/MS withdrawal penalty is not a post-PG service bond. University share subject to revision. MD/MS Junior Resident basic pay Level 10 ₹56,100–177,500 plus applicable allowances and increments; no fixed take-home stipend is quoted.
financials.instituteName: Vardhman Mahavir Medical College and Safdarjung Hospital
